newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hitachi Tool, three others to merge Oct 1.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi Tool, three others to merge Oct 1.

text.p: Hitachi Tool Engineering Ltd said on Tuesday that it plans to merge with Uozu Manufacturing Co Ltd and two other companies on October 1.
"We have decided to merge with the aim of improving the efficiency of our business operations," Hitachi Tool Engineering said in a statement.
Hitachi Tool Engineering manufactures precision cutting tools and Uozu Manufacturing produces drills for the steel industry.
Both firms are affiliated with Hitachi Metals Ltd 5486 T.
The remaining two companies in the merger are Yoneda Kogu Seisakusho KK, a subsidiary of Hitachi Tool Engineering, and a wholly owned subsidiary of Yoneda Kogu, the statement said.
The statement also said that 0.5 shares of Uozu Manufacturing and 0.5 shares of Yoneda Kogu would be exchanged for every Hitachi Tool Engineering share.
It said the new merged company would have total assets of 18 billion yen and projected sales of 16.9 billion yen in the business year from April 1, 1997.
It forecast that sales would rise to 18.7 billion yen in the year after that.
